usecases.title: Deliver the Kestrel Runner launch spot
Inspect each launch-spot cut in a browser

criteria.text: Each delivered cut has a total duration of 12 seconds.
Each delivered cut runs at 30 frames per second.
Shot 1 occupies 0:00–0:03 in each cut.
Shot 2 occupies 0:03–0:07 in each cut.
Shot 3 occupies 0:07–0:12 in each cut.

expected.operand: teal running shoe with orange sole sliding in from the left against dark night-city background in shot 1

criteria.text: Shot 1 shows a teal running shoe with an orange sole sliding in from the left against a dark night-city background.
The shoe is fully inside the frame by 0:01 in each cut.
Shot 1's caption reads exactly 'Run the city' in each cut.
Shot 1's caption is fully visible by 0:01 in each cut.

expected.operand: orange sole close-up with the same teal-and-orange colourway as shot 1 in shot 2

criteria.text: Shot 2 shows a close-up of the orange sole in the same teal-and-orange colourway as shot 1 in each cut.
The KESTREL wordmark is absent at 0:03 in each cut.
The KESTREL wordmark is fully visible by 0:05 in each cut.
The price tag reads exactly '€149' in each cut.
The €149 price tag is visible at both 0:04 and 0:06 in each cut.
Shot 3's headline reads exactly 'Out 28 November' in each cut.
Shot 3's button is labelled exactly 'Get early access' in each cut.
The early-access button is fully visible by 0:09 in each cut.

expected.operand: KESTREL wordmark visible in every shot 3 frame

criteria.text: The KESTREL wordmark is visible throughout shot 3 in each cut.

expected.operand: each text layer fully inside the frame in every frame

criteria.text: All text stays fully inside the frame throughout each cut.
The 9:16 cut measures 1080×1920 pixels.
The 16:9 cut measures 1920×1080 pixels.
The 1:1 cut measures 1080×1080 pixels.

expected.operand: text or button occupying the top 14% of the 9:16 frame

criteria.text: No text or button occupies the top 14% of the 9:16 cut's frame.

expected.operand: text or button occupying the bottom 35% of the 9:16 frame

criteria.text: No text or button occupies the bottom 35% of the 9:16 cut's frame.

tests.title: Check the complete 1:1 Kestrel Runner spot
tests.summary: Check the 1080x1080 contact sheet's duration, fps, timed three-shot composition, text, price, button, and framing.

steps.heading: Step 1
steps.body: Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=1x1 in the browser and reach the ready 1:1 Kestrel Runner contact sheet.

steps.heading: Step 2
steps.body: On the 1:1 sheet, inspect the header's measured dimensions, frame rate, duration and listed shot boundaries, then assert it reports 1080x1080 pixels, 30 fps, 12 seconds, shot 1 at 0:00–0:03, shot 2 at 0:03–0:07, and shot 3 at 0:07–0:12.

steps.heading: Step 3
steps.body: On the 1:1 sheet, compare the shot 1 frames from 0:00 to 0:01 with their layer facts, then assert a teal running shoe with orange sole slides in from the left over a dark night-city background, the shoe is fully inside the frame by 0:01, and the caption reads exactly 'Run the city' and is fully visible by 0:01.

steps.heading: Step 4
steps.body: On the 1:1 sheet, inspect the shot 2 frames at 0:03, 0:04, 0:05 and 0:06 with their layer facts, then assert the orange-sole close-up retains shot 1's teal-and-orange colourway, the KESTREL wordmark is absent at 0:03 and fully visible by 0:05, and the price tag reads exactly '€149' and is visible at both 0:04 and 0:06.

steps.heading: Step 5
steps.body: On the 1:1 sheet, inspect the shot 3 frames and their layer facts from 0:07 through the end of the displayed shot, then assert the headline reads exactly 'Out 28 November', the button reads exactly 'Get early access' and is fully visible by 0:09, and the KESTREL wordmark is visible in every displayed shot 3 frame.

steps.heading: Step 6
steps.body: On the 1:1 sheet, inspect the text layers' fully-inside-frame facts for every displayed frame, then assert every displayed text layer stays fully inside the frame.

steps.heading: Step 1

tests.title: Check vertical launch-cut reserved bands
tests.summary: Across the 9:16 contact sheet, prove text and button occupy neither the top 14% nor the bottom 35% of the 1080x1920 frame.

steps.heading: Step 1
steps.body: Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=9x16 in the browser and reach the ready 9:16 Kestrel Runner contact sheet.

steps.heading: Step 2
steps.body: On the ready 9:16 contact sheet, enable Show safe zones and inspect the text and button layers in every displayed frame against the shaded top 14% band and the facts table, then assert no text or button occupies the top 14% of the frame.

steps.heading: Step 3
steps.body: On that 9:16 sheet, inspect every displayed frame and its text and button facts against the shaded bottom 35% band, then assert no text or button occupies the bottom 35% of the frame.

steps.heading: Step 4
steps.body: On the 9:16 sheet, inspect the fully-inside-frame fact for each text layer in every displayed frame, then assert every displayed text layer stays fully inside the frame.
